policy: Explicit user text permitted; no independent private-record retrieval; authenticated owner history and deliberate feedback sharing
checks: forward correction preserves nonempty predecessor feedback history and usage ledger
explicitly submitted ordinary-word/business/message text is processed and stored only in own assistant history
submitted business dates and quoted names remain usable without a blanket sensitive-text ban
other-account Admin and inactive cannot load append or clear owner conversation
foreign ids and caller-forged prior turns rejected before inference
follow-up context comes from server-owned turns and never crosses account boundaries
configured-provider invalid AI summary rejected without persistence
valid generated summary saved only after deliberate confirmation; private chat is not attached
rejected handler/direct-RPC feedback does not persist or appear in PostgreSQL error logs
private history tables deny direct access and service role cannot execute history RPC
injection cannot select private records or forge citations; service has only metering and write-only assistant-turn operations
stale turn writes rejected and Clear assistant chat deletes owner history
reply-derived follow-up relevance never inherits stale capability claims or grants authority
limits: No perfect semantic private-content detection claimed
PostgreSQL SET ROLE/JWT-sub fixture, not full HTTP Auth transport
No hosted schema/log configuration audit; infrastructure configured to log all statements/parameters remains a release concern
Permitted chat text intentionally persists in owner-scoped bounded history and may be processed by the configured provider
